title: AI mediation of economic decisions: eight registered forecasts to 2031
description: EA-MEDIATED-SHARE-01 (#1632, September 2026) registers eight forecasts on AI-mediated commerce, each with a check date. They forecast AI-referred dollar share at the end of 2026, agent-executed share in 2030, the scope and revision of the McKinsey and Bain headline figures, professional-services citation rate, machine-readability spread, accuracy reporting and the comparability of platform denominators. One unbuilt test specifies a randomised inscription trial against conventional structured data, scored for accuracy rather than presence.

claims.statement: 1. **AI-referred dollar share, end of 2026.** Requires AI-referred session share **and** relative average order value, or directly reported revenue share, for a period ending Q4 2026. Conversion differential alone will not settle it. Check 2027-03-31. Claim: 3 to 8 percent at v = 1, restated if v is published.
claims.falsifier: If AI-referred dollar share at end of 2026 is below 1 percent, the retail channel is further out than this assumes. It would not establish a ten-year delay, and it would say nothing about mediation in fields these instruments do not observe.

witnesses.scope: A vendor benchmark that publishes an accuracy rate by industry, separated from mention and visibility, two months before the claim was registered. The witness scores claims about companies against their own sites, which may be narrower than entity-resolution accuracy, and the page offers no open sample, so the stricter falsifier of #1632 (stated rubric and open sample) is met only in part.

source.title: The State of AI Brand Intelligence 2026

finding.quote: July 2026 · Built with the Faro Method · faroindex.ai
The share of verifiable AI claims that match the company's own site or trusted sources
finding.from: report page, definition of Brand Accuracy Rate (BAR)

finding.quote: Visibility tells you whether AI mentions you. Accuracy tells you whether what it says is true.
Where accuracy breaks down by industry
504 companies completed, 503 in the reporting set after deduplication.
Roughly fifteen buyer-intent queries, four platforms, four repetitions each, up to 240 responses per company.

witnesses.shows: A commercial benchmark of 503 companies reports a Brand Accuracy Rate (share of verifiable AI claims matching the company's own site or trusted sources) ranked across 21 industries, and states the separation of accuracy from visibility in so many words. It existed before PRED-1632.A7 was registered on 2026-09-20.
witnesses.does_not_show: An open sample, raw responses or query library; independent validation of its scoring; resolution of entity identity (which entity a composition picks) as distinct from factual match of claims about a known company.

claims.statement:
Design, stated so it can be criticised before it runs: entities matched on field and size; randomised to inscription against conventional structured data, **not against nothing**, because a buyer's real choice is against the alternative; fixed query sets issued before treatment across at least three surfaces, since only 11 percent of domains are cited on two; outcomes scored for **accuracy** on the declared rubric rather than presence; commercial events tracked to something the firm can see; failures recorded and published with successes.

That design is also what would put a number on p, which is the term nobody has.
